decision: Close separately optimized attention followed by analytic decoder extraction. Although attention cosine clears the local cosine threshold, the decoder is unstable under the fitted-attention covariate shift. Authorize one joint full-operator conformance fit of the same existing layer at the fixed V377 coverage; add no parameters or inference operations.
claim_boundary: Negative existing-architecture layer-zero evidence only; no checkpoint, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
